focus.title: 美国拟扩大对华先进芯片出口管制，新增量子计算与AI训练芯片类别
focus.summary: 2026年10月6日，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）发布拟议规则，计划将量子计算芯片、AI训练专用芯片及配套EDA工具纳入对华出口管制清单，并扩大「外国直接产品规则」适用范围。新规预计影响中国云计算、自动驾驶及大模型企业的供应链。建议出海企业立即排查美国原产技术占比，评估替代供应商，并在合同中增设出口管制合规条款与不可抗力条款。
focus.title_en: US Moves to Broaden Chip Export Controls on China, Adding Quantum and AI Training Chips
focus.summary_en: On October 6, 2026, the US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued a proposed rule to add quantum computing chips, AI-training-specific chips, and related EDA tools to the export control list for China, while expanding the Foreign Direct Product Rule. The new rules are expected to impact the supply chains of Chinese cloud computing, autonomous driving, and large-model enterprises. Outbound companies should immediately assess the proportion of US-origin technology, evaluate alternative suppliers, and incorporate export control compliance and force majeure clauses into contracts.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，确立互惠关系新标准
case.summary: 2026年9月，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗中新建材贸易合同纠纷中，依据《中新关于承认与执行商事判决的谅解备忘录》及普通法互惠原则，承认并执行了中国某中级人民法院的生效判决。法院明确，中国法院对新加坡判决的承认实践可作为互惠事实证据。该案为中国企业在新加坡及普通法国家追索债务提供了重要先例，建议在跨境合同中优先选择新加坡法院管辖或约定仲裁。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026.09
case.title_en: Singapore International Commercial Court Recognizes and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Setting New Reciprocity Standard
case.summary_en: In September 2026, the Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC), in a China-Singapore building materials trade contract dispute, recognized and enforced a final judgment of a Chinese Intermediate People's Court based on the China-Singapore Memorandum of Understanding on Recognition and Enforcement of Commercial Judgments and common law reciprocity principles. The court clarified that Chinese courts' practice of recognizing Singaporean judgments can serve as evidence of reciprocity. This case provides an important precedent for Chinese enterprises seeking debt recovery in Singapore and common law jurisdictions. It is advisable to prioritize Singapore court jurisdiction or arbitration in cross-border contracts.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动「白名单」制度，便利金融与医疗数据合规传输
policy.summary: 2026年10月，广东省及香港、澳门特区联合发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动白名单管理暂行办法》，率先在金融、医疗、贸易领域允许符合条件的企业在备案后向港澳传输指定数据。白名单企业需通过数据保护影响评估并接受年度审计。该政策为跨境业务提供了合规通道，建议大湾区企业尽快申请白名单资质，建立数据分类分级制度，并完善与港澳合作方的数据保护协议。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政数局、香港创新科技署 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches Cross-Border Data Flow 'Whitelist' to Facilitate Compliant Financial and Medical Data Transfers
policy.summary_en: In October 2026, Guangdong Province, Hong Kong, and Macao jointly issued the Interim Measures for the Administration of the Cross-Border Data Flow Whitelist in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. The measures allow qualified enterprises in finance, healthcare, and trade to transfer specified data to Hong Kong and Macao after filing. Whitelisted enterprises must pass a data protection impact assessment and undergo annual audits. This policy provides a compliance channel for cross-border operations. Greater Bay Area enterprises are advised to apply for whitelist status promptly, establish data classification and grading systems, and improve data protection agreements with Hong Kong and Macao partners.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Data Bureau, Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Commission · 2026.10

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期结束，出海企业需重构供应链碳合规
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟CBAM过渡期于2026年9月30日结束，10月1日起进入正式征收阶段，覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢。中国出口企业须提交经核查的嵌入碳排放数据，否则面临高额罚款。建议：一、立即对欧出口产品进行碳足迹核算；二、与欧盟进口商明确CBAM成本分担机制；三、考虑在合同中加入碳价调整条款；四、探索使用绿电或低碳原料以降低碳成本。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: EU CBAM Transition Period Ends, Outbound Firms Must Restructure Supply Chain Carbon Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU CBAM transition period ended on September 30, 2026, and the definitive regime starts on October 1, covering steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters must submit verified embedded emissions data or face heavy penalties. Recommendations: 1. Immediately calculate the carbon footprint of products exported to the EU; 2. Clarify CBAM cost-sharing mechanisms with EU importers; 3. Consider adding carbon price adjustment clauses in contracts; 4. Explore green electricity or low-carbon raw materials to reduce carbon costs.
